name: Food-Science Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
desc: Chewy bakery-size chocolate chip cookies made with brown butter chilled back to solid and a bread flour blend.

source.title: Food-Science Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 113g cold unsalted butter, cut into cubes
2 large eggs, plus 1 large egg yolk
1 (4.25 oz) Hershey's XL Special Dark bar, chopped

steps: Brown the butter: melt the 225g butter in a light-colored saucepan over medium heat, swirling often. It foams and crackles; keep cooking until the crackling stops and the milk solids turn deep amber and smell nutty, about 2-3 min after the popping stops.
Pour the butter into a glass or steel bowl, scraping in every browned bit. Refrigerate until solid again, 1 1/2 to 2 hr.
In a stand mixer with the paddle, beat the solid brown butter, cold cubed butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar on medium only until combined, with no butter lumps left.
Beat in the eggs, the yolk and the vanilla until smooth.
In another bowl, whisk the all-purpose flour, bread flour, baking soda, baking powder and fine salt. Fold into the butter mixture until no dry streaks remain.
Fold in the chocolate chips and the chopped bar.
Scoop 100g balls onto a parchment-lined tray, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hr.
Heat the oven to 375°F and line baking sheets with parchment. Space the chilled balls 3 in apart, about 6 per sheet.
Bake 12-14 min, until the edges are golden brown and the centers still look slightly underdone.
Right out of the oven, rap the tray on the counter 2-3 times to ripple the edges and sprinkle flaky salt at once. Rest 10 min on the pan, then move the cookies to a rack.
tips: Chilling the brown butter back to solid lets it cream like regular butter.
The bread flour and all-purpose flour blend is what gives the chew.
The reel does not give a chip amount; 1 1/2 cups follows Handle the Heat's brown butter cookie, which has a similar butter and flour weight.
